name: savvy-progress
description: Progress bar above the prompt for /savvy-flow, plus an agents panel (/agents-info): running, finished and planned subagents with model, task progress, context, cost and time. Fork of johnnyvizz/claude-kit's savvy-progress: the terminal panel draws an animated Claude crab per agent that acts out what the agent is doing, a progress bar with state colours, a task bar, and an expandable tool log per agent.

language.title: Panel language
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale; en, ru or he (Hebrew, drawn right to left)

autoOpen.title: Open the agents panel
autoOpen.description: savvy: when a savvy-flow worker starts or a plan is reported; any: also when any other subagent starts

crabs.title: Crabs in the terminal panel
crabs.description: walk: each agent's pixel crab steps while it runs; still: the crabs are drawn but never move; off: a coloured mark instead of a crab
